bias.label: Leaning down below 3,870; testing the 3,850 low

event: Fed Chair Warsh speaks today, Mon 16 Nov, at 19:00 SAST (12:00 ET, Fed calendar). Before that: Empire State 15:30 SAST and Fed's Williams 16:05 SAST. FOMC minutes Wed 18 Nov at 21:00 SAST.

bullets.title: Asia gains faded
bullets.text: Gold was up at 3,892 at 02:50 SAST (Reuters) but slid to about 3,845-3,850 by 08:30 SAST (TokenPost, FXEmpire).

bullets.title: Weekly loss
bullets.text: Gold fell about 4.5-4.7% last week to a one-year low, and FXLeaders says it has slipped below 3,851 today.

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: Reuters says CME FedWatch shows about 94% odds of a December quarter-point hike and 6% for a half-point.

bullets.title: Yields and dollar
bullets.text: The US 10-year closed Friday near 5.15% and the dollar index is near 18-month highs, around 103 (exact level UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Warsh at 19:00
bullets.text: A hawkish Warsh could push yields up and gold toward 3,800, while a cautious tone could give some relief (FXEmpire, KCM Trade).

bullets.title: Iran and oil
bullets.text: Reuters reports Iran firing drones at US bases in Bahrain, which can lift gold fast, but higher oil also feeds inflation and hike bets.

buy.title: Buy plan: hold at 3,823 (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 3,820-3,830, only after a dip that holds

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price dipping to 3,823 and a 15M close back up out of the zone.
A 1H higher low inside the zone, not a fast slice through it.
A cautious Warsh and US yields easing back toward 5%.
Take some profit at 3,852 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying just because gold looks cheap. It is at a one-year low and the trend is down.
A hawkish Warsh at 19:00 SAST can push price through 3,800 toward 3,760.
Fed hike odds near 94% mean bounces may be small and short.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 3,867-3,870

keys.label: Sell zone
keys.value: Rejection at 3,865-3,870, the broken Oct 30 low

look: Price bouncing back up to 3,865-3,870 and stalling there.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close near 3,870.
US yields staying above 5% and the dollar firm.
Take some profit at 3,823 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling right at 3,850 support. Wait for the retest of 3,870 instead of chasing.
Iran headlines can lift gold fast, so a 1H close above 3,895 can run to 3,903-3,920.
Warsh at 19:00 SAST can move gold fast either way. Avoid entering in the 15 minutes before he speaks.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
